question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

I would love to __organise __the farewell party at my house.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"organise"** means to arrange systematically; to put in order. (व्यवस्थित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She decided to organise her wardrobe by color and type of clothing.
 
 
 
• **"Arrange" **refers to putting things in a neat, attractive, or required order. (सज्जित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He arranged the books on the shelf alphabetically.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Derange **(विकृत करना): To disturb the arrangement or order of.

 
 
• **Example:** The sudden change in plans deranged all his previous arrangements.
 
 
 
• **Disorder **(अव्यवस्था): A state of confusion or a lack of order.
 
 
• **Example: **The house was in complete disorder after the party.
 
 
 
• **Confuse **(भ्रमित करना): To make someone unable to think clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were so complicated that they confused everyone.

The correct answer is Option 2</
